scenes.context: 用开车接孩子的例子说明：把相关或不相关的镜头放在一起产生暗喻作用，就是蒙太奇。
sentences: 一男子着急地开着车，看样子时间很紧迫。
A man drives urgently—clearly pressed for time.
pressed for time（时间紧迫）
为什么呢？哦，原来是着急接孩子放学。
Why? He's rushing to pick up his child.
pick up the child（接孩子）
当我们描述一个主题时，可以将一串相关或不相关的镜头放在一起，以产生暗喻的作用。
Describing a theme, you can cut related or unrelated shots together to create metaphor.
create metaphor（产生暗喻）
这就是蒙太奇。
That's montage.
montage（蒙太奇）
scenes.speak: A man drives urgently—clearly pressed for time. Why? He's rushing to pick up his child. Describing a theme, you can cut related or unrelated shots together to create metaphor. That's montage.

scenes.title_cn: 分镜蒙太奇的核心：关联
scenes.title_en: The Core of Montage Storyboarding: Connect…
scenes.context: 同样是切换镜头，普通分镜只是展示不同画面，蒙太奇式分镜在画面之间建立关联。
sentences: 同样是切换镜头，普通分镜只是展示不同画面。
Both cut shots, but plain storyboards just show different views.
plain storyboards（普通分镜）
蒙太奇式分镜则在画面之间建立关联。
Montage-style boards build connections between shots.
build connections（建立关联）
可以是视觉上的（相似形状、颜色、动作），或语义上的（因果关系、对比关系）。
Visual (similar shapes, colors, motion) or semantic (cause-effect, contrast).
visual or semantic（视觉或语义）
观众在看到关联后，会自动脑补中间的故事。
Viewers fill in the missing story once they see the link.
fill in the story（脑补故事）
scenes.speak: Both cut shots, but plain storyboards just show different views. Montage-style boards build connections between shots. Visual (similar shapes, colors, motion) or semantic (cause-effect, contrast). Viewers fill in the missing story once they see the link.

scenes.context: 相似构图颜色、动作方向一致、意义因果递进，三种方式让观众参与叙事。
sentences: 第一种：两个镜头中有相似的构图、颜色，切换时产生呼应。
First: similar framing or color in two shots creates a call-back.
a call-back（呼应）
第二种：上一个镜头的动作方向和下一个镜头一致，形成流动。
Second: matching action direction flows across the cut.
matching direction（方向一致）
第三种：两个镜头在意义上形成因果递进，观众脑补中间的叙事。
Third: causal progression lets viewers infer the middle.
causal progression（因果递进）
关联越巧妙，观众的参与感越强，蒙太奇的效果也就越好。
The cleverer the link, the stronger the engagement and the better the montage.
stronger engagement（参与感更强）
scenes.speak: First: similar framing or color in two shots creates a call-back. Second: matching action direction flows across the cut. Third: causal progression lets viewers infer the middle. The cleverer the link, the stronger the engagement and the better the montage.

scenes.context: 新手以为分镜就是多切几个角度，但没有关联设计就只是多机位记录。
sentences: 很多新手认为分镜就是多切几个角度。
Many beginners think storyboarding means cutting more angles.
more angles（更多角度）
但如果没有画面之间的关联设计，切再多角度也只是多机位记录。
Without linking design, extra angles are just multi-cam recording.
multi-cam recording（多机位记录）
分镜的价值在于每个镜头都在推动叙事或含义的发展。
A board's value is each shot advancing the narrative or meaning.
advance the narrative（推动叙事）
scenes.speak: Many beginners think storyboarding means cutting more angles. Without linking design, extra angles are just multi-cam recording. A board's value is each shot advancing the narrative or meaning.

scenes.context: 拍前画分镜表，练习视觉关联与动作关联，控制单镜头时长。
sentences: 拍之前先画一个简单的分镜表：每个镜头要传达什么信息、和上下镜头的关联是什么。
Sketch a board first: what each shot conveys and its link to neighbors.
a storyboard table（分镜表）
练习视觉关联：在两个场景中寻找形状、颜色相似的物体，让它们成为切镜的连接点。
Practice visual links: find shape- or color-similar objects as cut points.
cut points（切镜连接点）
练习动作关联：拍摄一个人从左跑出的镜头，下一个镜头让他从右跑入。
Practice motion links: run left in one shot, run in right in the next.
motion links（动作关联）
控制单镜头时长：一个镜头超过几秒还没新信息，观众就会开始走神。
Control shot length: past a few seconds without new info, viewers drift.
viewers drift（观众走神）
scenes.speak: Sketch a board first: what each shot conveys and its link to neighbors. Practice visual links: find shape- or color-similar objects as cut points. Practice motion links: run left in one shot, run in right in the next. Control shot length: past a few seconds without new info, viewers drift.

scenes.context: 分镜关联需要前期规划，适合叙事类短视频，不适合直播和一镜到底。
sentences: 分镜关联需要前期规划，不是后期能完全补救的。
Linking needs pre-production planning; post can't fully save it.
pre-production（前期规划）
适合叙事类短视频、短片创作。
It fits narrative short videos and short-film creation.
narrative shorts（叙事类短片）
直播类、单镜头长记录、纯教程的一镜到底，则不太适用。
Live streams, single-shot records, and one-take tutorials need it less.
one-take tutorials（一镜到底）
scenes.speak: Linking needs pre-production planning; post can't fully save it. It fits narrative short videos and short-film creation. Live streams, single-shot records, and one-take tutorials need it less.

practice: Cutting related or unrelated shots together creates metaphor.
Montage-style boards build visual or semantic links between shots.
Similar composition, matching motion, and causal progression.
Sketch what each shot conveys and its link to neighbors.
Linking needs pre-production; it fits narrative shorts.
pitfalls: Without linking, extra angles are just multi-cam recording.
A weak forced link is worse than none.
Ignore sound as a cut point.
Sound can be a connecting edit point.
shifts: 用 montage（蒙太奇）、storyboard（分镜）、cut point（切镜点）
用 visual connection（视觉关联）、semantic connection（语义关联）、causal progression（因果递进）
用 viewer inference（观众脑补）、narrative engagement（参与叙事）、push the story（推动叙事）
